name: @pm/htmx
description: The htmx variant (editorial-build slice E; PLP build 2026-08-28): hypermedia — server-rendered HTML from a hand-written Worker, the pinned htmx.org runtime vendored into the variant's own assets and served same-origin. REQUEST-TIME — trays are fetched through the edge Worker per request via this Worker's own pm-edge service binding (ADR-0002 §7); serves /htmx/editorial/ and /htmx/plp/ through the composed origin. The PLP is this paradigm's arm of the data-strategy comparison (ADR-0005 §1: server loaders + progressive enhancement).
